Claim boundaries

  • The horizontal waveform coordinate is computed from accepted endpoint time, cycle start, and accepted cycle duration; the nominal grid count is display metadata only.
  • PV paths use the real predecessor followed by accepted endpoints. No last-endpoint-to-first-endpoint segment is invented.
  • An exact calcium event inside an accepted interval is shown at its exact time; the accepted endpoint remains the state readback owner and no intermediate state is interpolated.
  • Without a real predecessor, raw endpoint plots and ranges remain visible, while phase, work, morphology, and closed-cycle claims are unavailable.
  • LA/LV PV morphology and the LA/LV/Ao pressure waveform use absolute intracavitary/node pressures with one pressure reference.
  • Transmural pressure remains the constitutive-law and wall-work owner; it is not substituted into the displayed PV morphology.
  • Total blood volume is protocol/audit readback only. This review neither defines nor adjusts the 5522.11 mL operating point.
  • PVein→LA is one aggregate modeled pulmonary-venous edge, not separate clinical vein measurements.
  • This sidecar does not claim current ModelCore/browser-runtime adoption or time-step robustness.
